title: NHN KCP Mobile Identity Verification
description: Connects NHN KCP mobile identity verification to the G7 core identity verification infrastructure.

settings.title: NHN KCP Mobile Verification Settings
settings.description: Configure the operating mode, live credentials, and duplicate signup blocking rule.

info.activation: Enable identity verification under [Settings > Identity Verification].
info.logs: Verification history is available under [Admin > Identity Verification Logs], filtered by 'NHN KCP Mobile Identity Verification'.

settings.test_mode_hint: In test mode the plugin connects to the KCP test environment and no verification fees are charged.
settings.live_mode_warning_body: Live mode performs real verification with your merchant site code. Enter the live site code and encryption key before going live.
settings.section_live_keys: Live credentials (required when test mode is off)
settings.live_site_cd_hint: Enter your KCP site code without the leading SM. The SM prefix is added automatically.
settings.web_siteid_hint: Enter the site identifier issued in your KCP merchant admin. It is used to receive the duplication information (DI).

duplicate_field.label: Duplicate check basis
duplicate_field.hint: DI identifies the same person within this site only; CI identifies the same person across all institutions. (Default: DI)

duplicate_block_enabled.label: Block Duplicate Signup
duplicate_block_enabled.hint: When enabled, a verified person who already signed up with another email cannot sign up again. Disable it when one person legitimately needs multiple accounts (shared family phone, B2B). (Default: enabled)
duplicate_block_enabled.note: Signing up again with the same email is always blocked regardless of this setting (core default).

duplicate_field.warning: Changing this in production may temporarily weaken duplicate checks for existing members.

modal.title: Mobile Identity Verification
modal.description: Complete carrier verification in the KCP verification window.
modal.mobile_description: You will be taken to the verification screen and returned here automatically when it is done.
modal.adult_description: Mobile identity verification is used to confirm that you are 19 or older. You will return to the previous screen automatically.
modal.test_mode_notice: Test mode — no real verification is performed.

in_progress.title: Continue in the verification window
in_progress.hint: If the window does not appear, allow pop-ups in your browser. You can retry after closing it.

modal.popup_blocked: The pop-up was blocked. Allow pop-ups in your browser and try again.
modal.payload_not_ready: Verification is not ready yet. Please try again in a moment.
modal.mobile_return_success: Identity verification is complete. Please continue.

is_adult.label: Adult
is_adult.unknown: Cannot determine (date of birth not provided)

pending.title: No identity verification yet.
pending.hint: You can verify your identity when performing an action that requires it (password reset, profile change, and so on).

errors.not_adult: This service requires adult verification. Only users aged 19 or older can proceed.
errors.duplicate: An account already exists for this identity. Please sign in or reset your password.
errors.remote_call_failed: Failed to communicate with the verification provider. Please try again in a moment.
errors.decrypt_failed: The verification result was not valid. Please try again.
errors.incomplete_identity: The verification result was not valid. Please try again.
errors.not_found: The verification session has expired. Please start again.
errors.already_consumed: The verification session has expired. Please start again.
errors.binding_mismatch: The verified identity does not match this account.
errors.storage_failed: Failed to store the verification result. Please try again in a moment.
errors.verify_failed: Identity verification failed. Please try again.

adult_verification.label: Adult Verification (NHN KCP only)
adult_verification.description: Map this purpose to the NHN KCP provider only. Mail/SMS providers do not return a date of birth, so adult status cannot be determined.
